verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents that mail is opened and scanned in its own access-controlled facilities, with high-resolution scans and digital copies stored in the cloud. That goes beyond an envelope photo. AI summaries of mail content also imply the contents are scanned. Missing for 10: any evidence of searchable/OCR PDF output, a stated scanning turnaround (same or next business day), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
